evals.name: resume-after-compaction
assertions: Uses the schema-v1 work-item manifest as primary stage inventory
Verifies drift-prone external state instead of reconstructing stable stage history
Preserves conservative evidence and human-review status boundaries
Keeps canonical writes out of installed skill copies

evals.name: closed-mission-projection
assertions: Projects the case ledger from the manifest
Records the case and delivery state in both contract and manifest
Produces one close-cycle receipt with handoff, case, git, and promotion state
Generates reviewed SkillKit outcome annotations without inventing missing proof

summary: Static contract evaluation across two transfer scenarios shows the candidate preserves the released evidence boundaries while adding manifest-first resume, close-cycle projection, and reviewed outcome annotation. Candidate passed 8 of 8 assertions, released skill passed 3 of 8, and no-skill passed 0 of 8.
limitations: This is a deterministic instruction-contract comparison, not an agent-output benchmark.
Prospective cycle-time and external-finding outcomes remain to be measured on real work-item manifests.
